title: Urban Legend Cellars
specs: Scenic views of San Francisco Bay and city from outdoor tasting areas
Must be 21 or older to purchase or receive alcoholic beverages
Supervised children welcome; well behaved pets welcome outdoors on leash; service animals welcome indoors and outdoors
Tastings for 1-8 people no charge; groups 9-16 pay $25 per adult with bottle service
includes: Complimentary seated tastings for wine club members
Wine tasting includes a light snack
Bottle service includes one bottle per 2.5 adults for groups 9-16
blurb: Urban Legend Cellars is an artisan winery located in Alameda's Spirits Alley. Guests can enjoy tastings indoors or outdoors with views of San Francisco Bay. The winery offers personalized wine club memberships and hosts food trucks on weekends.
extraNote: Wine purchases only shipped within the United States; no shipping to AL, AR, DE, ME, MS, NH, RI, UT · All alcoholic beverage shipments require signature of non-intoxicated adult 21+ · Returns accepted only for flawed or corked products; must return unfinished portion if possible · Ground shipments outside CA, NV, AZ may be delayed by weather; express shipping available year round in some states · Winery tasting room and patio in Alameda's Spirits Alley
